for the websit ehero background, i like the fact its animated but i twould prefer a different approach. Build a responsive React component for an animated halftone dot-field background. Use the attached image as the visual reference.

VISUAL DESIGN

A perfectly regular square grid of circular dots on a black background. The dots are white or light grey, with generous space between them.

Every dot must remain at its original x/y coordinate throughout the animation. Animate its radius and, optionally, its opacity. Do not move the dots, distort the grid or animate the spacing.

Create broad, smooth waves of larger and smaller dots that flow across the background. The motion should feel slow and continuous, like light passing across a surface. Neighbouring dots should change together, forming coherent patterns rather than flickering independently.

Start with approximately 26px grid spacing, dot radii ranging from 1px to 5px, and a 24-second loop.

ANIMATION

Generate a smooth, time-varying field and sample it at each dot’s fixed position. Map that value to the dot’s radius and optional opacity.

Combine several periodic waves with different directions, scales and phases to create organic, evolving patterns.

The animation must loop seamlessly, with no visible jump, pause or change in movement at the loop boundary. Do not generate fresh random values on every frame.

SVG SHAPES

Allow me to upload an SVG and use its silhouette as an animated mask within the field.

The shape must appear through changes in dot size and brightness, not as a solid graphic placed over the dots. The silhouette can drift, orbit, rotate and pulse while every dot remains stationary.

Include controls for shape size, intensity, edge softness, travel distance, movement path, rotation and pulsing. Shape movement must also loop seamlessly.

CONTROLS AND RANDOMISATION

Provide controls for animation speed, loop duration, wave scale, complexity, direction, grid spacing, minimum and maximum dot radius, contrast, opacity, dot colour and background colour.

Add a Randomise button that creates a new composition and seamless motion loop using a new seed. Vary the wave structure and shape movement, but preserve my chosen colours, grid settings and uploaded artwork.

The same seed and settings must reproduce the same animation. Include Undo, pause/play, timeline scrubbing and settings import/export.

IMPLEMENTATION

Render using Canvas 2D inside a reusable React component. Keep the controls separate so the animation can also be used as a clean website background.

Handle resizing and high-density screens. Respect reduced-motion preferences and avoid React state updates on every animation frame.

Provide a standalone HTML demo as well as the React component.

AVOID

Drifting particles, connecting lines, constellation effects, random blinking, grid displacement, camera movement, 3D perspective, glow and gradient-mesh backgrounds. - i actually dont need it to be confgurable - i will let you pick the best patter and animation
